comment: While she may seem to know what she's talking about, she is very pedantic. I've heard the same from other students who complain about her superiority complex. Actually, other professors also complain that she is unwilling to do any service for her department, placing herself above others. Take another elective.

Long readings that she goes over in class, midterm and final are worth 60% of the grade. Very engaging and willing to work and meet outside class, but readings can sometimes feel not used as final and midterm uses very little material from the course compared to all the readings you will do.  Super nice and interesting lectures.

Great professor. Incredibly knowledgeable, articulate and personable. She cares about her students but definitely expects a lot. I would recommend taking her if you are genuinely academically curious and want to learn.

My least favorite professor this sem. Didn't like the teaching style, we would read before class and then she would summarize the reading we did for hw during class. The class wasn't engaging and I didn't get a chance to establish a personal connection like I did with other profs. She grades easy and is an interesting person, but not very caring.

Overall grade is not based on much. Midterm and final count for 30% each. Daily graded homework which can be stressful. Great lectures. She leaves time for questions each class, will revisit topics if we didn't understand. Can be flippant towards students being stressed about her class but she's kind and funny. Concepts can be dense and difficult.

Absolutely loved Dr. Joireman, she was amazing in class and always kept my attention. Did a great job at answering questions in a clear manner, allowed time at end of each class to answer any extra questions. Class is based on heavy and sometimes dense readings so I recommend you get ahead of those.

I'm not sure why people have had poor experiences with Dr. Joireman. She is such an experienced, knowledgeable professor who chooses extremely interesting and diverse topics to cover in class. From my experience, she doesn't grade too harshly either and offers plentiful opportunity to meet with her. Definitely recommend!

I've had Joireman twice and she's extremely knowledgable and interesting. She assigns a good amount of work and her tests are fair. They were by no means the hardest classes I've taken at Richmond, but you have to work for a good grade. She is straightforward in class, very open to questions, and gives clear instructions for assignments.

Take her class seriously.  She's good and knows what she's talking about, but it's not easy by any means.  One of my favorite professors, but also pretty easy.  She's very feedback oriented and willing to work with you if you want it, so take advantage.

The class is unstructured. The readings are extremely long and make no sense. No relation  to IS. She is  extremely unclear about what she wants. Tests are hard. Doesn't cover anything on the test in class.  She is not understanding at all. Never taking her again.
Worst Professor I have had at UR. A lot of boring readings and never discusses any in class. Is unclear and hard. Would not recommend.

NEVER take this professor. She is ruthless and simply should have been licensed to teach. Struggled with depression my freshman year of college and she actually encouraged me to withdraw from the course the last week before final exams because she didn't feel like reading a late paper. Simple a devil on Earth. NEVER take her. NEVER.

A pretty good professor overall. She brought a lot of Poly Sci/IS stuff into our class, but was very enthusiastic about Tolkien. Sometimes was unclear on what we were supposed to do, but was available for help when asked
The tests are pretty hard. Sometimes I dont know when she taught that. Grading is quite clear but not super clear.

Great professor! She loves the subject, and did a great job for her first semester of teaching this class. Really engaging during class, and wants to get to know you. Long readings, but it isn't always necessary to read. Follow her directions on rubrics and you'll get a good grade.
shes a fun lady but she's so tough when she grades. wanted to study international studies but after taking this class, no thanks. take this class if you like long boring readings
